clue.text: Case, and the information I have on it

indicators.note: on says the I-have piece is placed after the it piece

parts.note: GEN is informal British slang for information
taken as written
I have contracts to I've

explanation.surface: A lawyer is assembling the facts of a case, with what they know about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Case' is a grammatical case here, not a legal one.
explanation.definitionFit: The genitive is a grammatical case, the one showing possession.

clue.text: Be received in eastern warehouse

definitions.meaning: a speech may ... well, that is, be received
in India and East Asia a warehouse is called a ...

explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb for being received, and an Anglo-Indian word for a warehouse.

clue.text: Not ferrous, so easy to care for

definitions.meaning: fabric that needs no pressing after washing

explanation.definitionFit: Literally lacking iron, and the label on fabric that never needs pressing.

clue.text: Unexpected change — ossuary deposited in elaborate rotunda

indicators.note: deposited in says one piece is placed inside the other
elaborate suggests the letters of rotunda are worked over into a new shape

parts.note: an urn holds a person's remains, as an ossuary holds bones

explanation.surface: A bone urn has been placed in a fancy domed building, a surprise development.
explanation.walkthrough: An ossuary is properly a bone vault, loosely an urn for remains; 'elaborate' scrambles the domed building's name to TAROUND, and 'deposited in' sets the vessel within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden reversal of fortune or policy is a complete change of direction.

clue.text: Show-jumper seen in the gym?

parts.note: a show-jumper suggests an equestrian horse, but the gymnasium one is a padded box leapt over in gymnastics

explanation.definitionFit: Gym apparatus that people leap over, named after a horse, so a jumper in a gym.

clue.text: Indian doctor, one in favour of war

parts.note: MO is Medical Officer, a doctor
a hawk is a supporter of military action

explanation.surface: A hospital doctor from India turns out to be a warmonger.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mohawk are a Native American people, once called Indians.

clue.text: Warthog recognised to some extent as a man-eater

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A warthog is identified, partly, as a dangerous man-eating beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairy-tale ogres are giants that feed on humans.

clue.text: A broken leg requires support letters here set out the problem

definitions.text: letters here set out the problem

indicators.note: broken says the letters of leg are smashed into a new order

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: Someone with a fractured leg needs support while letters explain the issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' turns LEG into LGE. The definition describes the subject: in algebra, letters stand for numbers in setting out a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Algebra is mathematics in which letters represent quantities in an equation.

clue.text: Author of book The Meadow

parts.note: Kings is a book of the Old Testament
a ley or lea is a meadow

explanation.surface: Looks like the writer of a pastoral book called The Meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Kingsley was a Victorian novelist, a well-known writer.

clue.text: Assume stupid person has no explanation

indicators.note: has no says one piece is taken away from the other

parts.note: a donkey is slang for a fool
the key to a map or puzzle explains it

explanation.surface: To take it as given that a fool has no account of himself.
explanation.definitionFit: To don a garment, or an air, is to put it on, to assume it.

clue.text: Heraldic officer with make-up and women's clothing on

parts.note: rouge is cheek make-up
drag is women's clothes worn by a man
taken as written

explanation.surface: A herald turns up in cosmetics and a dress.
explanation.walkthrough: Rouge Dragon is one of the pursuivants of the College of Arms in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Rouge Dragon is the title of an officer of arms, a junior herald.

clue.text: To term clerics eccentric creates a great disturbance

indicators.note: eccentric says the letters are put into an odd order

explanation.surface: Calling the clergy oddballs causes a big upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' rearranges all thirteen letters of TO TERM CLERICS.
explanation.definitionFit: A thunderstorm with lightning is a violent atmospheric upheaval.

clue.text: Jingoism that is beginning to scare authorities

parts.note: a war rant, ranting for war, is jingoism
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

indicators.note: beginning to says only the opening letter of scare is used

explanation.surface: Warmongering nationalism is starting to frighten those in power.
explanation.walkthrough: Read WARRANT as WAR RANT for jingoism.
explanation.definitionFit: A warranty is a written authorisation or guarantee, so the plural fits authorities.

clue.text: Bird twice observed on island

indicators.note: on says the twice piece follows the island piece

parts.note: bis is Latin for twice, used in music for a repeat

explanation.surface: A bird spotted twice on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibis is a long-billed wading bird.

clue.text: Does racist need to be reformed or banished?

indicators.note: reformed says the letters are rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: Should a bigot be made to change his ways, or simply thrown out?
explanation.definitionFit: To be ostracised is to be shut out from society, exiled.

clue.text: Man going back into pub — that's natural

indicators.note: into says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: going back says the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: Rob is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man returning to the pub feels it is only natural.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is any man's name here; 'going back' turns it to BOR, and 'into' places that within the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: An inborn quality is innate, present from birth.

clue.text: Opera the French produce with uniform reduction.

parts.note: Tosca is Puccini's opera
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French production of an opera mounted with cutbacks.
explanation.definitionFit: A model built to scale is reduced in proportion throughout.

clue.text: French delicacy — English way to get hold of a consignment

indicators.note: to get hold of says the way piece grips the consignment inside it

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
a cargo is a consignment of goods

explanation.surface: An English route for collecting a shipment of fine French food.
explanation.definitionFit: Escargot is the French word for an edible snail, a gourmet dish.

clue.text: Stout stem

definitions.meaning: to stop a flow, of blood for example

explanation.definitionFit: An adjective meaning steadfast and a verb meaning to stop a flow.

clue.text: Good man has a job with local employer, initially

parts.note: a post is a job

indicators.note: initially says each word gives only its first letter

explanation.surface: A virtuous man has a position with a nearby firm.
explanation.definitionFit: An apostle is a devout follower and missionary, a good man.

clue.text: Attack — raid on Mobile

indicators.note: mobile means moving about, so the letters shift into a new order

explanation.surface: A raid launched on the city of Mobile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mobile' looks like the Alabama city but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An inroad is a hostile incursion into territory.

clue.text: For instance, a leader

definitions.meaning: the word 'a' is an example of the indefinite one in grammar

explanation.definitionFit: The word 'a' is an example of this part of speech, and a leader is an editorial in a newspaper.

clue.text: Overthrown ruler taking refuge in no-go area of America

indicators.note: overthrown says the whole is turned upside down, read backwards in a down clue
taking refuge in says the ruler piece sits inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A deposed monarch hides in a forbidden zone of the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'Overthrown' turns the whole of NOGERO (the Queen's cipher inside, per 'taking refuge in') upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregon is a state in the north-west of the United States.

clue.text: A donkey without its tail is going wild

indicators.note: without its tail says the last letter is dropped

parts.note: moke is British slang for a donkey

explanation.surface: A donkey that has lost its tail is running riot.
explanation.definitionFit: To run amok is to behave wildly and uncontrollably.

clue.text: Piece of writing abridged by alternative originator of suit

parts.note: prose is written work
cut means shortened
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A text shortened by another person who started the lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: A prosecutor brings legal proceedings, starting the case.

clue.text: Can move around

definitions.meaning: to agitate a liquid with a spoon

explanation.definitionFit: Two slang and plain senses: prison, and to mix by moving round.

clue.text: Visit racetrack and get ruined

explanation.definitionFit: Literally attending greyhound racing, and idiomatically falling into ruin.

clue.text: One playing a small part making business good

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a business

explanation.surface: A minor player making a company prosper.
explanation.definitionFit: A cog in a machine is a minor but necessary component.

clue.text: Soldiers being captured, they can provide an explanation

indicators.note: being captured says the soldiers are held inside the other piece

parts.note: taken as written
OR is Other Ranks, soldiers

explanation.surface: Prisoners of war may be able to explain what happened.
explanation.definitionFit: A theory is a proposed account explaining something.

clue.text: A little boy has swallowed a fly

indicators.note: has swallowed says the fly piece goes inside the boy piece

parts.note: a son is a boy
a midge is a small fly

explanation.surface: A small boy has gulped down an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A smidgeon is a tiny amount, a bit.
